content.short: Roll provides infrastructure for social money.
content.description: Roll provides the infrastructure layer for social money, enabling people to own, control, and monetize the value of their social interactions across platforms. It uses ERC20 tokens or fancoins as the social currency, enabling portability and interoperability of value. For developers, the Roll API exposes endpoints that can be integrated into applications, making it straightforward to add social-money functionality to existing programs and workflows.
